notes.title: When dragging multiple lines, play a sound.
notes.notes: When dragging multiple lines, play a sound.

notes.title: Added super undo function
notes.notes: Added super undo function, which can be executed by pressing and holding the undo button for 2 seconds. It will undo to the vicinity of the last temporary line at one time.

notes.title: Added the function of highlighting a line and change the BGM
notes.notes: Keep the mouse still and on a line for 2.5 seconds to highlight the entire line

notes.title: Added 3x3 map size.
notes.notes: Added 50 levels and level generator in 3x3 map size. The [b]AutoCross [/b]feature is changed to not work in 50 levels of 3x3 map size.

notes.title: Added auxiliary function for automatic cross
notes.notes: Default closed. Click the [b]computer [/b]button to turn on or off. After activation, the Cross will be placed based on the already placed lines and simple logic to speed up the problem-solving process (for experienced players). It's not the final answer, just removing numerous simple actions. It is disabled in levels 1-50 of the 5x5 map.

notes.title: Add a temporary Line to mark the rollback point. Improve UI operability
notes.notes:
1. A [b]Pencil[/b] button is added to switch on and off the temporary line. It can be used to mark a key fallback position.  The temporary line is different in appearance, but its function is the same as the standard line.Press and hold the [b]Pencil[/b] button for 2 seconds to convert all temporary lines to standard lines. The [b]P[/b] key performs the same function as the [b]pencil[/b] button, except that it cannot be held down.

2. Move the undo, redo, and pencil buttons from the settings to the toolbar, which stays at the top of the screen.

3. Fixed the issue where pressing the left button on the UI and sliding the mouse over the screen would display a preview.

notes.title: Changed the position of the toolbar menu
notes.notes: Changed the position of the toolbar menu to keep the [b]reset [/b]button away from the [b]undo [/b]and [b]redo [/b]buttons to avoid accidentally touching the [b]reset [/b]button.

notes.title: "Infinite" Update
notes.notes:
Now you can generate [u][b]Infinite[/b][/u] levels through the level generator.
The level generator can generate 6 levels and 3 levels of difficulty.
Just click ∞ in the buttons above to switch to the Infinite mode. The level selection button is no longer displayed in the Infinite mode. Instead, there are 3 difficulty choices. Each click will generate a new level of corresponding difficulty. You can restart the level by clicking the restart button, so you can restart any level.

notes.title: Make the operation more comfortable.
notes.notes:
Added Preview of drag operation to make the operation more comfortable.
The W S A D key moves the map more smoothly, and the map drag is more precise. Now you can use the middle mouse button to drag the map.

notes.title: New font and shadows
notes.notes:
Changed the font to match the game interface.
Added the number of shadows to replace the original translucent, you can press N to switch to the original translucent mode

notes.title: Added some useful features
notes.notes:
Hold the left and right mouse buttons to drag the camera.
Add some function keys:
Q E zoom in and out.
W S A D or up down left right move the camera 
[ ] Undo redo
Added sound effects
